bank.explanation: Active listening allows you to gather essential details while making the caller feel heard and supported during a crisis

Transfer the call immediately to a supervisor without taking details
Listen actively and ask clear questions to identify the location and nature of the fire
Interrupt the caller frequently to ensure you are in control of the conversation

bank.question: A pump operator notes the intake pressure is 2.1 bar. After 10 minutes of pumping, it drops to 1.45 bar. What is the total reduction in bar?
bank.explanation: Subtract the final pressure from the starting pressure: 2.1 - 1.45 = 0.65
